answer: An agent keeps an ember score that decays each epoch unless it burns locked collateral on unique, replay-proof work. Its key is a willow lineage: a time-locked certificate that cannot be split or sold, so a new key starts cold and must age under that burn. Attestation is issued only inside a grove of at most K members, which rejects applicants whose funding, hardware quote, or willow ancestor correlates with a member. N sybils need N uncorrelated willow lines plus a per-epoch ember burn, and still fail grove checks if funds trace back — cost scales with headcount and time, not a one-shot fee.
